channel.title: Trần Hải Đăng — Bách khoa cá nhân
channel.description: Một cuốn bách khoa cá nhân về toán học, ảnh chụp, và những ngày đáng nhớ.

item.title: The Basel Problem, and Why Euler's Proof Still Feels Like Magic
item.description: How a sum over the squares turned out to hide π, and what Euler's 1735 argument still teaches us about guessing beautifully.

item.title: Cantor's Diagonal Argument, Slowly
item.description: The diagonal argument is short, but its sentences are easy to say and hard to mean. This is the version I wish someone had shown me first.

item.title: A Night in Đà Lạt, and the Arithmetic of Fog
item.description: A remembered evening in the highlands, filed under days worth keeping — with a small detour into contour lines.

item.title: Reading Notes: Hilbert's Programme and Its Aftermath
item.description: Notes from a slow reread of the Hilbert–Gödel story, with the benefit of hindsight and the disadvantage of a short attention span.
